integrity: The infinite-dimensional result is proved by finite-band block counting and a uniform geometric-tail comparison. Finite numerical tests are corroborative, not a proof; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: All asymptotics hold for each fixed geometric weight 0<q<1. No uniform estimate near q=1, optimal second term, or complete closed-form finite singular spectrum is claimed. Unindexed historical quantitative results remain a novelty risk.
title: Elliptic Weyl coefficient and quantitative singular decay of geometrically weighted Cesàro averaging
